prompt: We're shipping a new component in our design system at Lumen Health (patient scheduling app) called the Time Slot Picker, and I'm doing the launch page that goes on our internal design system site. What it is: a grid of selectable appointment times grouped by day. Key points: it supports keyboard arrow navigation, it announces selection to screen readers, it handles 'no times available' with an empty state that offers the next date with openings, and it has two densities (comfortable and compact). Status is 'Stable, v2.1'. Replaces the old Dropdown Time Select. Don't make up adoption stats or quotes, we haven't measured anything yet. Please build the page as one HTML file, inline CSS, no external assets or images. I'd like the component itself to appear live on the page.
pick_rule: Chosen as the task with the largest judged difference in favor of the skill among tasks where the skill loaded.

images.alt: Time Slot Picker launch page: top navigation, breadcrumb, title, summary and two tags, then a Live demo heading and introduction; the live component begins in the lower half of the screen.
